title: Instrument T9 Action Compass controlled reproducibility replay
objective: Implement the smallest research-only controlled replay fixture and semantic comparator for the existing CHIEF_REPRODUCIBILITY / T9 test so identical frozen fixtures can be evaluated for exact machine-action/state/warning agreement while allowing bounded non-semantic metadata or wording variance. Do not create market semantics or historical pseudo-rows.
allowed_change_scope: scripts/learning/directly related T9 Action Compass reproducibility runner/comparator
tests/fixtures/directly related synthetic Action Compass replay fixtures
06_RESEARCH_LAB/forward_tests/directly related machine-readable T9 runtime/readback artifact if existing owner routing requires it

evidence.summary: T9 is registered with zero rows and CONTROLLED_REPLAY_FIXTURES_NOT_CREATED as blocker.
Existing Action Compass owner authorizes receipt implementation, binds T9 as reproducibility owner and forbids historical backfill.
Existing validator freezes controlled machine semantics but does not implement T9 replay comparison.

reproduction: On fresh main, confirm T9 remains QUEUED_RECEIPT_VALIDATOR_AVAILABLE with rows_total 0 and blocker CONTROLLED_REPLAY_FIXTURES_NOT_CREATED; confirm Action Compass validator exists but no bounded T9 replay runner/fixture comparator produces semantic-match/disagreement results. Do not use historical chats as fixtures.

positive: Identical frozen fixture semantics across repeated outputs classify SEMANTIC_MATCH even when allowed producer metadata or wording differs.
Repeated fixture evaluation creates no additional prospective Action Compass decision receipt and no market action.
negative: Changed action, Lane-3 state or warning under the same fixture is detected as semantic disagreement.
Pre-activation, mutable-latest reconstruction and historical-chat fixture attempts fail closed and cannot count as T9 prospective evidence.
